note: Both sets share the same defects: truncated model values (F2 'BSP-L-65014', WC 'C454CUFG#0'), truncated locations (SV/SH 'BATHROOM' instead of BATHROOM SHOWER, F2 'BATHROOM' instead of BATHROOM VANITY), the MWD02 dimension row actually belonging to MWD01, and a vague 'Shower' location claim. Set A keeps the plumbing tags as conditions on the faucet claims (F1/F2), which matters because the two faucets have different models and locations, while Set B drops those conditions and leaves the faucet model and location claims ambiguous. Set B does bind the shower-valve manufacturer claim correctly to SHOWER VALVE where A writes only 'Shower', but A's conditioned faucet claims are the more valuable and faithful additions.
remarks: The text layer is heavily truncated in the FINISH SCHEDULE block (e.g. 'QU', 'FIE', 'PR', 'DE', '33', 'EG'), so finish-schedule claims cannot be verified from text alone; the image also shows a FLOOR FINISH SCHEDULE (LM/PT1/PT2/VT) that the text layer omits entirely. Several claims in both sets are duplicates of the same fact stated with a truncated and a full value (WC model, F2 model). Truncated quotes such as 'LOCATION: BATHR' and 'DESCRIPTION: SHOWE' do not fully support their claims in either set.
